description: A helper class for managing a SQLite database that stores GPS location data, including methods for creating, upgrading, inserting, reading, and deleting location entries.

classes.name: LocationDbHelper
classes.description: A SQLiteOpenHelper subclass that manages the creation, upgrade, and data operations for the location database.

methods.name: LocationDbHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the database helper with context.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the location table in the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops existing table and recreates it during database upgrade.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a LocationEntry object into the database.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LocationEntry objects for a specific day based on a Calendar object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a specific day, identified by a string or Calendar object.
